newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the U.S. dollar and the mark, but closed firmer agaisnt sterling and the rand on Thursday, foreign exchange dealers said.
"There wasn't much activity in the market. A few people were just buying to cover their short positions," one dealer commented.
He said the local unit finished a cent lower against the U.S. dollar at 11.1500/1600 compared to Wednesday's 11.1400/1500 and dropped to 6.5000/5100 from 6.4920/5000 against the German mark.

It however registered gains on sterling at 17.9700/9900 from 18.0010/0250, tracking a stronger U.S. dollar on the British unit overseas and also edged up to 2.4900/5100 from 2.5015/5190 against South Africa's rand.
